summary_ar: تلاوة خاشعة لآيات من سورة مريم، تبدأ من قوله تعالى عن من كفر بالآيات وتستمر ببيان بطلان دعوى نسبة الولد لله تعالى وجلال ملكه وشمول عبوديته لخلقه.
summary_en: A recitation of verses from Surah Maryam, rebuking those who disbelieve in the signs of Allah and refuting the claim that the Most Merciful has taken a son.

tags.why: The recording is a recitation of verses from Surah Maryam.

audience.why: General Quranic recitation accessible to all listeners.

claims.claim_en: Recitation of Surah Maryam (19:77-96) dealing with the denial of resurrection, refutation of taking idols or sons to Allah, and the final assembly of all creation as servants before Him.
